title: PPS: Plug-and-Play Saccadic Vision for Fine-Grained Classification
abstract: arXiv:2509.15688v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fine-grained visual classification benefits from high-resolution inputs to resolve subtle, localized cues, but at the cost of large compute and memory budgets. Inspired by human saccadic vision, we propose a lightweight extension that turns any pretrained backbone with spatial feature maps into a saccadic classifier through glimpse-induced inference. The only architectural additions are a small priority head and a single cross-attention fusion block. The same weight-tied encoder encodes a downsampled peripheral glance, exposes the spatial feature map from which the priority head predicts a glimpse-priority distribution and re-encodes high-resolution glimpse crops sampled from that distribution in parallel. A sequential sampler with non-maximum suppression draws a runtime-configurable number of glimpses. A residual multi-head cross-attention block then fuses the glance against the glimpses. translated_title: PPS：面向细粒度分类的即插即用扫视视觉
translated_abstract: 细粒度视觉分类受益于高分辨率输入来捕捉细微的、局部化的线索，但这需要付出巨大的计算和内存开销。受人类扫视视觉的启发，我们提出了一种轻量级扩展，通过注视诱导推理，将任何具有空间特征图的预训练主干网络转变为扫视分类器。唯一的架构新增是一个小型优先级头和一个单一的交叉注意力融合模块。同一个权重共享的编码器对下采样的周边一瞥进行编码，输出空间特征图，优先级头据此预测注视优先级分布，并并行地对从该分布中采样的高分辨率注视裁剪区域重新编码。一个带非极大值抑制的顺序采样器提取运行时可配置数量的注视区域。随后，一个残差多头交叉注意力模块将周边一瞥与注视区域进行融合。为了提升优先级
tldr: 提出了一种即插即用的扫视视觉方法PPS，仅通过轻量级的优先级头和交叉注意力融合模块，就能将任意预训练主干网络转变为受人类扫视启发的注视式分类器，在细粒度分类任务中以更低的计算和内存开销捕捉高分辨率的局部细微线索。
en_tdlr: PPS is a plug-and-play saccadic vision extension that turns any pretrained backbone into a glimpse-based classifier with only a lightweight priority head and a cross-attention fusion block, enabling fine-grained classification to capture high-resolution localized cues at reduced compute and memory costs.
